name: Centre Point
description:
Located at the Centre Point Shopping Mall building.
Peak hours: Morning (07:30–10:30), Afternoon (11:30–14:30), and Evening (16:30–18:30).
Accessible via Jalan Tun Razak, Jalan Coastal, and Jalan Laiman Diki.
Kota Kinabalu’s major road network connects seamlessly to other towns in Sabah via federal roads and highways.
Close to major tourist spots and shopping areas.
